userStories.title: Move completeAsWithFallback out of the agent manager
acceptanceCriteria: `completeAsWithFallback` imported from `@/agents/manager-complete-as`, called with an input whose `completeWithFallback` stub resolves an outcome with output `ok`, returns that outcome.
That call invokes the input's `dispatchEvents.emitDispatch` exactly once.
When the input's `completeWithFallback` stub rejects with a `NaxError`, `completeAsWithFallback` rejects with that same error and invokes `dispatchEvents.emitDispatchError` exactly once.

routing.reasoning: Mechanical extraction of one method body into a new module with a one-line delegation; no behaviour change and no credential logic itself.

userStories.title: Provider-scoped fail-auth that recovers when the credential changes
acceptanceCriteria: `failurePolicyFor("fail-auth").cooldownScope` is still `"agent"`.

On an `AgentManager` whose `native` tiers `balanced` and `fast` resolve to `openai-codex/...` and `minimax/...` models, `markUnavailable("native", <fail-auth>, "balanced")` makes `isUnavailable("native", "balanced")` true.
After that call, `isUnavailable("native", "fast")` is false.
`markUnavailable("claude", <fail-auth>, "fast", "claude-sonnet-4-6")` on a manager with no `claude` models config still makes `isUnavailable("claude", "balanced")` true.
A `fail-auth` cooldown marked for `native` on `openai-codex` survives `resetTransientUnavailable()`.
After that `fail-auth` on `native`, `isUnavailable("native")`, a probe with no tier and no model, is true.
After that `fail-auth`, on a manager whose fallback map for `claude` is the flat list `["native"]`, `nextCandidate("claude", 0, "claude")` returns `null`.

With `_agentManagerDeps.servedAuth` stubbed to return fingerprint `aaa` for `openai-codex`, `markUnavailable("native", <fail-auth>, "balanced")` leaves an `authCooldowns()` entry whose `auth` is `{ providerId: "openai-codex", fingerprint: "aaa" }`.
`markUnavailable("native", <fail-rate-limit>, "balanced")` leaves no `authCooldowns()` entry.
`markUnavailable("claude", <fail-auth>)` leaves no `authCooldowns()` entry.
`refreshAuthCooldowns()`, after `_agentManagerDeps.readCredential` resolves and `servedAuth` now returns fingerprint `bbb`, makes `isUnavailable("native", "balanced")` false.
That refresh logs one `info` entry on scope `agent-manager` with message `Credential changed for openai-codex — native available again` and data `previousFingerprint` `aaa` and `fingerprint` `bbb`.
Two `refreshAuthCooldowns()` calls started together, in that changed-fingerprint state, log the `available again` line once in total.
`refreshAuthCooldowns()` while `servedAuth` still returns `aaa` keeps `isUnavailable("native", "balanced")` true and logs no `info` entry.
`refreshAuthCooldowns()` when `_agentManagerDeps.readCredential` rejects keeps `isUnavailable("native", "balanced")` true and resolves without throwing.
A `fail-auth` marked while `servedAuth` returned `undefined` for `openai-codex` is released by `refreshAuthCooldowns()` once `servedAuth` returns any fingerprint.
`refreshAuthCooldowns()` never calls `_agentManagerDeps.readCredential` for an agent-wide `claude` `fail-auth` entry.

`AgentManager.runWithFallback`, on a request for agent `native` at tier `balanced` (fallback enabled, `claude` in the fallback map), after a `fail-auth` on `native` and a fingerprint change from `aaa` to `bbb`, dispatches its first hop to `native`.
`AgentManager.runWithFallback` under the same setup, with the fingerprint unchanged, dispatches its first hop to `claude` and logs `Primary agent already unavailable — starting on fallback`.

`AgentManager.completeWithFallback`, with primary `claude` and `{ agent: "native", tier: "balanced" }` in its fallback map, after `native` was cooled by a `fail-auth` with fingerprint `aaa` that has since changed to `bbb`, swaps to `native` when `claude` fails with `fail-rate-limit`.

`AgentManager.completeWithFallback`, when its first hop on `native` with model def `{ provider: "openai-codex", model: "gpt-6.1-sol" }` returns `fail-auth`, leaves an `authCooldowns()` entry with `providerId` `openai-codex`.
`AgentManager.completeWithFallback`, when a `claude` hop with model def `{ provider: "anthropic", model: "claude-sonnet-4-6" }` throws an auth error, makes `isUnavailable("claude")` true.

routing.reasoning: Cross-module change (cooldown store, manager, fallback loop, new auth module) handling credential fingerprints with concurrency-sensitive release logging and tight size/complexity ratchets; credential handling triggers the security override to three-session-tdd.

suggestedCriteria: `CooldownStore.release(key)` returns false when no entry exists for that key.
`CooldownStore.authCooldowns()` omits an auth-stamped entry whose cooldown has expired.

userStories.title: Re-login hints at the failure and at run end
acceptanceCriteria: `authReloginHint("openai-codex", { providerId: "openai-codex", kind: "oauth", expires: <now + 1 day> }, <now>)` returns `Login for openai-codex was rejected before its recorded expiry (expires <that ISO time>). Run: nax auth login openai-codex`.
`authReloginHint` with an `oauth` entry whose `expires` is at or before `now` returns `Login for openai-codex was rejected. Run: nax auth login openai-codex`.
`authReloginHint` with an `oauth` entry that has no `expires` returns the same `Login for openai-codex was rejected. Run: nax auth login openai-codex` text.
`authReloginHint` with an `api-key` entry returns `API key for openai-codex was rejected. Check or replace it: nax auth login openai-codex (or nax auth import)`.
`authReloginHint` with no entry returns `Credentials for openai-codex were rejected. Check where they come from with: nax auth list`.

`reportAuthFailure("native", <fail-auth>, "balanced")` for an `openai-codex` tier, with `_agentManagerDeps.listStoredProviders` stubbed to return a future-dated `oauth` entry for `openai-codex`, logs one `warn` on scope `agent-manager` whose message is the `before its recorded expiry` hint.
Two `reportAuthFailure` calls for the same provider and fingerprint, started together, log one `warn` in total.
`reportAuthFailure` when the `listStoredProviders` stub rejects logs one `warn` with the `Check where they come from with: nax auth list` hint.
`reportAuthFailure("native", <fail-rate-limit>, "balanced")` logs nothing and records no notice.
`reportAuthFailure("claude", <fail-auth>, "fast")` logs nothing and records no notice.
`authRelogins()` after one reported `openai-codex` failure returns one notice with `providerId` `openai-codex`, `agent` `native` and the hint as `message`.
After a second report for `openai-codex` with a different fingerprint, `authRelogins()` returns one notice for `openai-codex`, whose `message` is the second report's hint.
`authRelogins()` after `refreshAuthCooldowns()` releases `openai-codex` returns an empty array.
`authRelogins()` after `reset()` returns an empty array.

`AgentManager.runWithFallback`, on a `native` request whose first hop returns a `fail-auth` adapter failure for an `openai-codex` model, logs the re-login `warn` before the swap to the fallback agent dispatches.
`AgentManager.runWithFallback`, on the same request with `agent.fallback.enabled` false, logs the re-login `warn`.
`AgentManager.runWithFallback`, on the same request with `noFallback: true`, logs the re-login `warn`.
`AgentManager.completeWithFallback`, on a `native` first hop returning `fail-auth` for an `openai-codex` model def with fallback disabled, logs the re-login `warn`.
A notice recorded on a declined swap, with no cooldown, is gone from `authRelogins()` after `refreshAuthCooldowns()` sees a changed fingerprint for that provider.

`runCompletionPhase`, in headless `normal` mode with an agent manager whose `authRelogins()` returns one notice, prints run-footer output containing `Re-login needed:` followed by that notice's message.
That `runCompletionPhase` call logs one `warn` on scope `execution` whose message is the notice's message and whose data carries `providerId`.
`runCompletionPhase`, with an agent manager whose `authRelogins()` returns an empty array, prints no `Re-login needed:` line.

`formatRunSummary` in `normal` mode with `authRelogins: ["Login for openai-codex was rejected. Run: nax auth login openai-codex"]` returns text in which a `Re-login needed:` line is followed by a line containing that hint.

When a provider released by `refreshAuthCooldowns()` fails `fail-auth` again with a new fingerprint, `reportAuthFailure` logs the re-login `warn` again and `authRelogins()` returns a single notice for that provider carrying the new hint.

routing.reasoning: Spans agents, execution and log-format modules with synchronous claim-before-await concurrency and pinned complexity/size ratchets; handles credential-failure reporting so the security override applies.

suggestedCriteria: `reportAuthRelogins(undefined, logger)` returns an empty array and logs nothing.
A notice for a declined-swap provider whose fingerprint is unchanged survives `refreshAuthCooldowns()`.

userStories.title: Workflow start lines name the fallback when the primary is unavailable
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Make `previewOpModel` name the first fallback candidate and its model, for a run-kind op whose primary endpoint is already unavailable when fallback is enabled.

**Motivation** — In the 2026-10-14 log, `branch-review start`, `branch-fix start` and `branch-rereview start` named `openai-codex/...` models while each step actually ran on `claude`.

**Approach** (verbatim from spec)

`previewOpModel(ctx, op, input)` (`packages/nax/src/operations/op-model-preview.ts`). Baseline: returns `{ agentName: target.agent, model: target.modelDef.model }` from `resolveOpEndpoint`. Target: it destructures `target`, `effectiveTier`, `effectiveModels` and `defaultAgent` from `resolveOpEndpoint`. When `op.kind === "run"` (the only kind whose dispatch probes the start agent), `config.agent.fallback.enabled` is true, and `ctx.runtime.agentManager.isUnavailable(target.agent, effectiveTier, target.modelDef.model)` is true, it takes `candidate = ctx.runtime.agentManager.nextCandidate(target.agent, 0)`:
- If there is a candidate, the preview is `{ agentName: candidate.agent, model }`. `model` is `candidate.model` when the candidate has a literal pin. Otherwise it is `resolveModelForAgent(effectiveModels, candidate.agent, candidate.tier ?? effectiveTier, defaultAgent).model`.
- A model that throws while resolving gives `undefined`, through the existing catch.
- With no candidate, the primary preview is unchanged.

Read-only symbols: `resolveOpEndpoint(...)` (`packages/nax/src/operations/call-dispatch-prologue.ts`) returns `{ defaultAgent, effectiveModels, resolved, effectiveTier, sessionRole, target }`; `resolveModelForAgent(models, agent, tier, defaultAgent)` (`packages/nax/src/config/schema-types.ts`) returns a model def with `.model` and throws when nothing resolves; `startStep(storyId, label, { model })` (`packages/nax/src/workflow/run-log.ts`) logs `<label> start` with the `agentName` and `model` the step model function returned.

The existing `previewOpModel` cases run with every agent available, so their expected previews are unchanged. Test helper note: `packages/nax/test/helpers/mock-agent-manager.ts` hard-codes `isUnavailable: () => false` and `nextCandidate: () => null`; the new tests override both.

**Scope** — In: `previewOpModel` change and its new test file. Out: auth cooldown/hint work (US-002/US-003); complete-kind ops; pipeline-mode stage start lines; credentials changing between the start line and dispatch.

**Interface**
```ts
// packages/nax/src/operations/op-model-preview.ts
// previewOpModel(ctx, op, input) -> { agentName: string; model: string } | undefined
// candidate = ctx.runtime.agentManager.nextCandidate(target.agent, 0)
// model = candidate.model ?? resolveModelForAgent(effectiveModels, candidate.agent, candidate.tier ?? effectiveTier, defaultAgent).model
```
acceptanceCriteria: `previewOpModel` for a run-kind op whose endpoint is `native` at tier `balanced`, with fallback enabled, `agentManager.isUnavailable` returning true for that endpoint, and `nextCandidate` returning `{ agent: "claude", tier: "balanced" }`, returns `agentName` `claude` and the model that `models.claude.balanced` resolves to.
The same preview with `nextCandidate` returning `{ agent: "claude", model: "opus" }` (a literal pin) returns `agentName` `claude` and model `opus`.
The same preview with `agent.fallback.enabled` false returns the primary endpoint's `agentName` and model.
The same preview with `nextCandidate` returning `null` returns the primary endpoint's `agentName` and model.
The same preview, when the candidate's tier resolves no model for that agent and the candidate has no pin, returns `undefined`.
When `isUnavailable` returns false, `previewOpModel` never calls `nextCandidate`.
For a complete-kind op with an unavailable primary and fallback enabled, `previewOpModel` returns the primary endpoint's `agentName` and model and never calls `nextCandidate`.

routing.reasoning: Single-function change in one source file with clear branches and no credential handling; standard pattern with a new test file.

outOfScope: A credential that changes between a step's start line and its dispatch; the start line may name the fallback, and the `available again` line follows.
Start lines of pipeline-mode stages; pipeline mode is frozen.
Complete-kind ops, whose dispatch never skips an unavailable primary at start.

analysis:
Feature: when a native provider rejects its credential (fail-auth), park only that provider (not every native tier), release the cooldown automatically when the stored credential's fingerprint changes (re-login / new key), warn once with a `nax auth login <provider>` hint (also repeated in the end-of-run summary), and make workflow start lines name the fallback agent/model when the primary is unavailable.

Key files (all under packages/nax unless noted): src/agents/manager.ts (exactly 600 lines = source limit, NO file-sizes-baseline entry: any net growth fails check:file-sizes); src/agents/manager-run-fallback.ts (runWithFallback, complexity baseline 52; precedent for a manager loop in its own module); src/agents/cooldown-store.ts (CooldownStore.mark/_live/sweepTransient); src/agents/cooldown-provider.ts (providerOf, read-only); src/agents/retry/failure-policy.ts (fail-auth: cooldown 'run', cooldownScope 'agent' - must stay 'agent'); src/agents/manager-types.ts (IAgentManager); src/execution/runner-completion.ts (runCompletionPhase, complexity baseline 34, must stay <=600 lines); src/log-format/summary.ts + types.ts + src/execution/lifecycle/headless-formatter.ts (RunSummary/RunFooterOptions/formatRunSummary); src/operations/op-model-preview.ts + call-dispatch-prologue.ts (previewOpModel / resolveOpEndpoint); src/workflow/run-log.ts (startStep, read-only). Read-only externals: servedAuth, naxCredentialStore, listStoredProviders from @nathapp/nax-agent; DEFAULT_AGENT_NAME in src/config/agent-defaults.ts; resolveModelForAgent in src/config/schema-types.ts.

Ratchets enforced by check:all: file-sizes (manager.ts, runner-completion.ts <=600) and complexity (runWithFallback 52, completeWithFallback 40, runCompletionPhase 34 must not rise). Therefore: logic lives in new modules (auth-cooldown.ts, auth-relogin.ts, auth-relogin-report.ts, manager-complete-as.ts); AgentManager members are one-line delegations to an AuthCoordinator; the three pinned functions gain only plain calls (no new if / ternary / && / || / ??). Biome cognitive complexity ignores `?.` and `await`. The `??` for authModel lives in markUnavailable (not ratcheted).

Story order: US-001 (pure refactor freeing manager.ts lines) -> US-002 (cooldown stamp + refresh) -> US-003 (hints, notices, footer); US-004 (preview of fallback in start lines) is independent.

Test touchpoints: test/unit/agents/manager-complete.test.ts, fallback-model-targets.test.ts, test/unit/operations/op-model-preview.test.ts; helpers test/helpers/mock-agent-manager.ts and fake-agent-manager.ts implement IAgentManager and must gain the new members (no-op refreshAuthCooldowns/reportAuthFailure, authRelogins returning []). mock-agent-manager hard-codes isUnavailable:()=>false and nextCandidate:()=>null; US-004 tests override both. Tests must stub _agentManagerDeps (servedAuth, readCredential, listStoredProviders) and never touch the real ~/.nax.

Risks: (1) CooldownStore key change only when `auth` stamp is passed - ACP agents and all other outcomes must keep today's keys; identity-less probes (no tier, no model) must still see a live stamped entry of that agent. (2) Concurrency: refresh must log 'available again' only when release() returned true; reportAuthFailure must claim its key synchronously before any await. (3) auth-cooldown.ts must never import manager.ts (deps passed in). (4) Accepted trade-offs: OAuth refresh-token rotation changes the fingerprint (one extra failing call); under auth.onChange 'refuse' recovery never happens in that run but the hint still names `nax auth login`. (5) Never log secrets - only fingerprints and provider ids. Never run bare `bun test` or `bun run nax`; run package commands from packages/nax.
outOfScope: Recovering an ACP agent (`claude`, `codex`, ...) after `fail-auth`; nax does not manage those credentials.
Retrying a `fail-auth` within the same agent call; the swap still happens immediately.
Refreshing an OAuth token earlier than its stored expiry.
Re-checking credentials on a timer; the check runs only at the start of an agent call.
A `fail-auth` hint in the TUI, other than through the log; the footer is printed in headless mode.
Recording a cooldown when a `fail-auth` swap is declined; only the hint is new on that path.
US-004 only: a credential that changes between a step's start line and its dispatch; the start line may name the fallback, and the `available again` line follows.
US-004 only: start lines of pipeline-mode stages; pipeline mode is frozen.
US-004 only: complete-kind ops, whose dispatch never skips an unavailable primary at start.
